newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen opening up as bull market forges on.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen opening up as bull market forges on.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open higher on Friday after taking a breather on Thursday, with no major factors seen knocking the market's recent furious bull trend.
The Dow Industrials stepped back from its recent record heights and closed off 12 to about 6418 on Thursday.
"We're probably headed for a higher opening. But I'm hoping for some profit-taking later in the session," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
"We've got import/export numbers coming in later, but I don't expect that to have much effect," he said.
At 1500 GMT, the government reports import and export procies for October and at 1900 GMT, federal budget data is due.
